meta.title: Pilot Convoi Slovakia — Oversized Load Escort & Pilot Car Services | 24/7
meta.description: Professional pilot car escorts for oversized and heavy transports across Slovakia and the EU. SK/CZ permit handling, route planning. Available 24/7 — +421 907 450 919.

hero.subtitle: Pilot vehicles for oversized and heavy loads across Slovakia and the entire EU. We ensure a smooth, safe and fully compliant passage for your cargo.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Complete service for oversized transport — from permits to a safe passage.

items.title: Oversized load escort
items.text: Professional pilot vehicles for oversized and heavy transports in Slovakia, Czechia and across the EU. Safe, reliable and fully compliant with legislation.

items.title: Permit handling (SK / CZ)
items.text: Complete arrangement of oversized transport permits, including all communication with the authorities. You take care of the cargo, we handle the paperwork.

items.title: Route planning
items.text: We design the optimal route, verify clearance of bridges and underpasses and make sure the whole transport runs smoothly.

about.title: About us
about.text1: Pilot Convoi Slovakia specialises in escorting oversized and heavy transports. Our experienced and reliable pilots ensure a safe and smooth ride for your trucks — a partner hauliers can always count on.
about.text2: We put emphasis on precision, professionalism and an individual approach to every customer. Every transport is prepared in advance — from the route through permits to the passage itself.

routes.title: Where we drive
routes.subtitle: The most frequent corridors of our escorts — from the Polish border to Ukraine, Hungary and Austria. But we go wherever your cargo needs to.
routes.note: We always adapt the route and timing to your transport — get in touch and we will prepare a tailored solution.

contact.subtitle: Need an escort or a permit for an oversized transport? We are here for you — around the clock.
contact.availability: NONSTOP 24/7 — you can reach us anytime.
